headline: Claude-Mem Gives Agents A Longer Memory
lede: Claude-Mem turns scattered coding sessions into a searchable stream of project history. SQLite, Chroma, lifecycle hooks, and progressive disclosure let agents retrieve the right context without replaying everything.

headline: Agents Learn To Operate The Desktop
lede: Agent Desktop replaces brittle pixel matching with a structured accessibility tree. Its observe–act–observe loop gives autonomous systems stable references, explicit errors, and a repeatable path across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

headline: Worktrunk Makes Parallel Git Workspaces Practical
lede: Worktrunk treats Git worktrees like ordinary branches, turning parallel agent work into a manageable terminal routine. Interactive selection, setup hooks, shared caches, and automated cleanup keep concurrent tasks from colliding.

headline: Colibrì Streams Giant Models From Local Hardware
lede: Colibrì treats disk, RAM, and VRAM as one tiered memory system for massive mixture-of-experts models. Its cache routes only active experts into compute, making frontier-scale inference measurable on consumer machines.

headline: A Field Guide For Better Coding Agents
lede: This collection packages disciplined engineering habits as composable agent skills. TDD, domain modeling, and requirement alignment replace improvisation with documented routines that developers can install, inspect, and adapt.

headline: Heretic Rewrites A Model Without Retraining
lede: Heretic turns local models into a laboratory for behavior modification, using ablation, configurable scorers, and automated parameter search. Refusal rates, style, and alignment become variables to measure rather than fixed properties of a checkpoint.

headline: Spotify Brings Portal Into Coding Agents
lede: Portal AI Plugins connect Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor to the service catalog and operational tools behind Spotify’s platform. Read-only diagnostics, dry runs, confirmations, and readiness checks put enterprise context within reach without surrendering control.

headline: Floci Rebuilds AWS On Your Own Machine
lede: Floci provides an AWS-shaped endpoint without accounts, credentials, or cloud bills. Docker-backed services, persistent storage options, and compatibility with Terraform, CDK, and familiar SDKs make local infrastructure a practical defensive boundary.

headline: An AI Watcher Hunts For The Right Listing
lede: ai-goofish-monitor runs continuously behind the scenes, searching Xianyu for listings that match natural-language requirements. Scheduled Playwright jobs, image-aware analysis, account rotation, and multi-channel alerts turn a marketplace search into a quiet monitoring service.

headline: Hex Puts Offline Voice At Your Fingertips
lede: Hex converts a keystroke and a spoken sentence into text pasted wherever the cursor sits. Once its model is downloaded, transcription stays on the device across macOS, Windows, and Linux—a small convenience with a firm privacy perimeter.
